as_told.title: Unblurred 2022 Google Earth imagery shows vehicle tracks around S4

plain: S4 is a site in the Nevada desert that a man named Bob Lazar has long talked about as a place where secret work on flying craft took place. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says images of the area were covered up on Google Earth, Google's online satellite map, and that a documentary called Project Gravitar goes into it. According to Michels, a researcher named Luigi Vendetelli used Google Earth's older archived pictures to go back to a 2022 image, taken before the site was blurred, which shows vehicle tracks around S4. A guest who goes by UAPGerb tells it too, crediting Luigi. He says Luigi carefully shows how plants and ground cover were rearranged around S4 sites, and he places S4 near Papoose Lake. So the story comes from the host and from a guest, both repeating one researcher's work with the satellite pictures. If they are right, someone has worked to hide a real place on a public map.
